source.quotedPhrase: Broad band with abstract cut-out & crystal detailing

sourceNotes.rawContent:
- Step into effortless elegance with this Crystal Cut-Out Band Ring, crafted from premium stainless steel and finished with rich 18K gold plating. The broad band features a unique abstract cut-out pattern, enhanced with sparkling crystals for a modern yet timeless look.
- With its anti-tarnish coating, this ring is designed to retain its shine for long-term wear, making it ideal for daily styling as well as special occasions. A perfect blend of durability, shine, and style — this piece is a must-have addition to your jewelry collection.
- Product: Anti-Tarnish Crystal Cut-Out Band Ring
- Material: Premium stainless steel
- Plating: 18K gold tone plated
- Finish: Anti-tarnish for long-lasting shine
- Design: Broad band with abstract cut-out & crystal detailing
- Style: Trendy, elegant & versatile
- Comfort: Smooth inner band for daily wear
- Occasions: Everyday use, parties, and gifting
